step.cmd: Carry the smart key or leave it inside the vehicle.
Make sure that the parking brake is firmly applied.
Shift the gear to P (Park). You cannot start the vehicle if the gear is in N (Neutral).
Press the ENGINE START/STOP button. If the hybrid system starts, the READY indicator displays.

info.p: The engine should start without engaging the accelerator whether the engine is cold or warm.

postreq.p: After you follow the starting procedure, the READY indicator displays on the instrument cluster.
